"""queue-relay-service: batch incoming messages and flush them downstream."""
import json
import pathlib

CONFIG = json.loads(pathlib.Path(__file__).with_name("config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

LISTEN_PORT = CONFIG["service"]["listen_port"]
FLUSH_INTERVAL_MS = CONFIG["service"]["batch_flush_interval_ms"]


def main() -> None:
    print(f"relay listening on :{LISTEN_PORT}")
    print(f"flushing batches every {FLUSH_INTERVAL_MS}ms")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
